summary: Westamerica Bancorporation filed an 8-K announcing a board-approved increase in its stock repurchase plan authorization by 2,000,000 shares, bringing total remaining authorization to 2,785,023 shares (11.8% of shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026). Repurchases may occur on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions through December 31, 2026. Chair/CEO David Payne cited financial strength and capital-management goals. No price or premium terms are stated. The program is accretive to EPS but execution depends on market conditions. Watch the pace of buybacks relative to authorization as a signal of management's capital-return appetite.
